en: The postcard is a black-and-white photographic card showing a waterfront with several buildings, including two prominent structures with towers, likely churches or important civic buildings, set against a background of trees. The card has Swedish text describing the location as 'Parti af Vifstavarv,' dated '12/11 06,' with handwritten cursive text below. The back of the postcard has an address written in Swedish, a green stamp from Sweden (Sverige), and is formatted in the typical divided-back style for addresses.
